book.name: Lucas
book.title: Evangelio según Lucas Jesucristo roy pjl̈ú ëre, e jyã tara Lucasdë

content: Öng wl̈ẽp ushko so jeno kjl̈ara
Jesús shäng oba ping wopro ga nopga dbur töngga Roma so kong, nopga owa wl̈eniyo obl̈ë, e shrono l̈öng ara ba kuk eshko.
Fariseoga, no pinggaga kjok l̇l̇gwekkl̈o tara Moisésdë l̈i go, e l̈öng eshko kjl̈öbö bakoe. Nopga owa l̈i ĩya l̈ok ga tjl̈ẽ ëng kong ga «Nopga wotjl̈ĩk owa wl̈okjre, ga ië ba tjok bakoe» l̈e.
Eni ga Jesús tjl̈ẽno ba kong l̇l̇ëbo jyãgl̈o go. Tjl̈ẽ ga

«¿Pjãy kjl̈ara öng wl̈ẽp ushko so tjeng dogl̈o sak dbäw (100), ga kjl̈ara jeno wl̈eni ga l̇l̇ëye shäryëp eshko? ¿L̇l̇amo sak shkaw kjingsho shkaw (99) l̈i iëp ber tjeng ba kjok kjing go, ga pja to jeno l̈i wl̈ẽk, äär jong wl̈ẽnop guing l̇l̇ëmdo?
Wl̈ẽnopshko ga pja wopjl̈úe. Eshko ga iëp buk bop dbopdo,
söp tek iröng bop ushko, ga bop pjeyoga rokëp uunkong tek eshko. Ga pja tjl̈ẽ ba kong l̈ok ga “Bor öng jeno l̈i wl̈ẽnore. Tja wopjl̈úe. Woydër ga pjãy ber wopjl̈ú botoya dik bakoe” l̈ëp eni.

»Eni bakoe. L̈ër bomi kong ga no kjl̈ara, l̇l̇ëbo owa shärye shäng l̈i, e owa jl̈õe l̈ara, ga rayarashko ga kjok dogo ga l̈öng wopjl̈ú ba kjĩshko. Eshko ga nopga pjl̈o bek dogl̈o sak shkaw kjingsho shkaw (99) l̈i, era woyotjl̈ĩya l̈ok ara l̇l̇ëme.
Dbur jeno kjwara
»¿Wal̈ë shäng kjl̈ara, dbur tjeng kjwo sak kjwara (10) ga jeno kjwara wl̈eni ga l̇l̇ëye shärye? ¿Iök borkeya, ga u ro pjl̈oke yõtso, ba dbur jeno l̈i wl̈ẽna guing l̇l̇ëmdo?
Wl̈ẽnashko ga ba pjeyoga roke tek eshko uunkong. Ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga “Bor dbur jeno l̈i wl̈ẽnore. Tja wopjl̈úe. Woydër ga pjãy ber wopjl̈ú botoya dik bakoe” l̈e eni.
»Eni bakoe. L̈ër bomi kong ga no kjl̈ara, l̇l̇ëbo owa shärye shäng l̈i, e owa jl̈õe l̈ara, ga rayarashko ga Sbö parkagaga kjok dogo so l̈öng wopjl̈ú eni bakoe» l̈e.
Wa jeno kjl̈ara
Eshko ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong obi ga «Domer sök kjl̈ara wapga do pjök.
Pjl̈ara ga ba wa miteyo tjl̈ẽ ba data kong ga “Data, bop l̇l̇ëbo ber bor kong l̇l̇ono wl̈o l̈i twos bor kong jekdo” l̈e. Kuya ga ba l̇l̇ëbo tjeng kës l̈i shdöra ba wapga do pjök l̈i kong.
»Dbar kjwöbö ga ba wa miteyo l̈i, l̇l̇ëbo twara ba kong l̈i soynena pjir, ga dburyo söra jek ba tjok, öötong beno sök kjok shto obl̈ë pjolae. Eshko ga ba dbur l̈i zana, to shäng sorë pogo.
Zana pjirshko ga kjok shäng l̈ishko ga pjl̈i shrono kësbang, ga l̇l̇ëye wl̈ẽya, ue wl̈o drete.
»Eni ga to shäng pak wl̈ẽk domer kjok eshko so kong, ga kong pak twara, ichara köchi dë ba kjokshko.
Parkëshko ga pjl̈i ara, köchi dl̈i worbo l̈i ue woydë, gueniyo twëba ba kong l̇l̇ëme.
»Eni ga wotjl̈ĩk tjwe kjl̈ay ga “Bor data ushko ga dl̈i träk l̇l̇ëm, ba parkagaga l̈öng kës l̈i bö tjung ĩyado, ga dl̈i ber obie. ¡Na ga tja sök wol̈onto pjl̈irë!
Tja to bor data shwoy iröng obi dey. Tja äär eshko ga l̈ër ba kong ga ‘Data, tja l̇l̇ëbo owa shäryono Sbö kong, bop kong bakoe.
Bek ga tja tjwl̈õ bop wa dik ame. Tja ios ber bop parkaga wl̈eni dey’ l̈ër ba kong eni” l̈e.
Eni ga to sök l̈ishko dwayo, jongya ba data shwoy. »Jek shäng ääto ga ĩna ba datarë pjola dwayo, ga songe l̈e. Jekdo eshko ga jek zron jong ba wl̈okjrë, popjl̈ura, ga l̈õ shira.
»Eshko ga ba wa l̈i tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga “Data, tja l̇l̇ëbo shäryono owa Sbö kong, bop kong bakoe. Bek ga tja tjwl̈õ bop wa dik ame” l̈e.
»Eshko ga ba data tjl̈ẽ ba parkagaga l̈öng l̈i kong ga “Pjãy shwong shis mal̈ing, pjl̈ú wl̈eniyo, ga doyozĩ e go. Kong sakkwo iokl̈o iozĩ kjwara, drepkwota iozĩ bakoe.
Sögl̈a l̇l̇gwokl̈ë kjl̈o pjl̈ú wl̈eniyo l̈i tek sözĩ, ga zrözĩa. Shji dl̈i shäryë, ba shrëkkl̈o.
Bor wa ëre shinmotkonoe l̈oror, miga shäng së. Jeno bor shjiryo, gueniyo shrono shäng iröng” l̈e. E irgo ga kjarga l̈öng ba shrëk.
»E wopro ga ba wa këguëyo shäng parkë kjl̈oshko. Tek shäng iröng tjwayde ushko ga kuya ga oba l̈öng bërkë.
Eni ga parkaga rokara kjl̈ara, tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga “¿E l̇l̇ëro?”
»“Bop l̈ëng shäng së, shrono shäng pjl̈úe. E kjĩshko ga sögl̈a l̇l̇gwokl̈ë kjl̈o pjl̈ú wl̈eniyo l̈i zröra bop datarë ba shrëkkl̈o” l̈e.
»Kuya ga iirkono, opzrëk jek woydë u roshko l̇l̇ëme. Miydara ba datarëshko ga opshino jek ba wl̈ẽpyotkë, opzrëk wl̈o.

Gueniyo tjl̈ẽ ba data kong ga “Miydëp pjl̈ú ga tja parkë shäng bop kong l̈uyo ara, pja kol̈ër ĩyado. Eni ëmdë ga tja kong shwl̈ing ushko so chirawa tworop bor kong, tja opshrëk bor pjeyoga tjok wl̈o pjl̈ara l̇l̇ëme.
Gueniyo bop wa bopoya, bop dbur zana dret wal̈ëga owa wl̈eniyo tjok l̈i, era kong sögl̈a l̇l̇gwokl̈ë pjl̈ú wl̈eniyo l̈i zrörop” l̈e.
»Kuya ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga “Pja sök bor tjok ĩyado, bor l̇l̇ëbo tjeng kës l̈i, e bopoya.
Gueniyo bop l̈ëng, e shinmotkonoe l̈oror, miga shäng së. Jeno bor shjiryo, gueniyo shrono shäng iröng obi. E kjĩshko ga shrëy l̇l̇ëm ga äe” l̈e ba kong» l̈e.

footnotes.text: L̈õ shik l̈anyo, e tak pjang Génesis 27.26 go.
